summary: Verified Emergent Google OAuth wiring on VulnOps platform alongside JWT auth. All 5 backend checks and all 4 frontend checks passed. No regressions detected.
passed: GET /api/auth/me with Bearer JWT -> 200 returning admin user payload
POST /api/auth/logout -> 200 and clears access_token + session_token cookies (Max-Age=0)
Frontend /login renders Google button with data-testid='google-signin'
Clicking Google button navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fremediationhub.preview.emergentagent.com%2F (origin URL-encoded as redirect param)
JWT email/password login regression: admin login from /login redirects to / successfully
AppRouter detects #session_id=fake_test_id, renders AuthCallback ('Completing sign-in…'), then redirects to /login?error=oauth on invalid session
notes: Real Google OAuth round-trip not testable without live Google account; error path validated instead. Logout sets cookies with SameSite=lax; google_session sets session_token with SameSite=none; Secure (cross-site cookie OK for production).
